name: Tera Holding
note: Turkish group active in finance, investment banking, portfolio management, technology, cyber-security, real estate, robotics and tourism; back-of-shirt sponsor of Beşiktaş's football and men's basketball teams from 2026-27 (era announcement 17 August 2026). Press describes Emre Tezmen as its main owner and largest shareholder (tera-tezmen-ownership). The September 2026 SPK fund liquidation and investigation of its chairman are financial records, which do not count for ratings under METHOD.md.
